title: One wish
checked: Every reachable state checked (9 states, 8 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 9 states is reached from the start, and every path can still reach its end (shipped, declined).
Nothing is planned, built or shipped unless you approved it in triage. An agent's moves (WorkItem::AGENT_TRANSITIONS) start at planned.
rules.path: Take away the approval guard and it breaks in 4 steps: embeddings cluster it, the judge ranks piles, triage drafts a spec, [the agent approves].

rules.rule: Nothing ships without a pull request
rules.says: Shipped work came through review with a GitHub pull request attached.
rules.path: Take away the pull request guard and it breaks in 6 steps: embeddings cluster it, the judge ranks piles, triage drafts a spec, [you approve], an agent picks it up, [merged, no PR].
